name: An Angel Without Her Wings
source:
A girl in a bad state of mind discovers someone who looks and sounds exactly like her. Things fall apart.

[From [url=https://air-gong.itch.io/an-angel-without-her-wings]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個精神狀態很糟的女孩發現，有個人長相和聲音都跟她一模一樣。一切就此分崩離析。

（摘自[url=https://air-gong.itch.io/an-angel-without-her-wings]itch.io[/url]）
